answers.core: The way this is currently handled is inconsistent. An overhaul would benefit all users of `GDScript` (which are a overwhelming majority of Godot users).
answers.workaround:
At the moment the only way to emulate the desired behavior is to write custom functions that will be called from `_process`, etc. and being custom functions can be overridden properly. 

However this workaround is messy and inconvenient.
